summary: Per-slot activation helper: computes an activation-byte address as array_base + 560*a2 + 248, where array_base is the dword read at obj+0 (dereferencing this+0). When the byte is zero the slot is marked active (byte set to 1) and the active-count dword at array_base + 0xE40C is incremented; the return value then becomes the container array base pointer. When the slot is already active the function returns the computed slot pointer unchanged and no counter update occurs.

local_names.this: pointer to a pointer; *this is the base of the slot array
local_names.a2: slot index used to compute the per-slot activation address
local_names.result: computed activation-byte pointer, replaced by the array base pointer when a slot is newly activated

operations.description: Compute the per-slot activation-byte address: array_base + 560*a2 + 248, where array_base is the dword read at obj+0 (dereferencing this+0).
If the activation byte at the computed address is zero (slot inactive), take the activation branch.
Set the activation byte to 1 to mark the slot active.
Reload the container array base pointer (*this) as the new return value.
Increment the active-slot count dword at array_base + 0xE40C.
Return the computed slot pointer when the slot was already active, or the container array base pointer after a new activation; the return contract differs by branch.
Invoked by TeamRadioNetworkMessageProcessing (0x0045F710) as part of slot activation.

unresolved: The constants 560 (element stride) and 248 (activation-byte offset within an element) are not named in the packet; the slot record layout is unconfirmed.
The return value differs by branch (computed slot pointer versus container array base), and the caller's expectation is not evidenced.

The packet classifies the +0xE40C target and the activation byte as reads (rw R) although the source increments and writes them; that R/W classification is inconsistent with the source and unresolved.
